tagline: A Fun and Simple Picture Book for Little Kids to Learn About Emotions: The Toddler's First Guide to Feelings from Happy and Sad to Angry and Surprised
title: A Toddlers First Guide to Feelings / Emotions: A Fun and Simple Picture Book for Little Kids to Learn About Emotions: The Toddler's First Guide to Feelings from Happy and Sad to Angry and Surprised
description:
An illustrated introductory feelings book designed to help toddlers identify and name emotions. It uses simple, expressive character faces to present feelings such as happy, sad, angry, surprised, and more.

The listing says the book helps build emotional vocabulary, supports children in expressing how they feel, encourages empathy, and creates opportunities for parent-child conversations. The description positions it for young learners ages 1–4, while the Amazon product details list a reading age of 3–10 years.
